title: Raise a custom exception
instruction: Write a function `check_age(age)` that raises a `ValueError` with the message `"Age must be 0-150"` if the age is outside that range. Otherwise, print `"Age is valid"`.

title: Graceful file reading
instruction: Write a program that tries to read a file called `data.txt`. If the file doesn't exist, print `"File not found, creating it..."` and create the file with the content `"New file!"`.
solution_code:
filename = "data.txt"
try:
    with open(filename, "r") as f:
        print(f.read())
except FileNotFoundError:
    print("File not found, creating it...")
    with open(filename, "w") as f:
        f.write("New file!")
